theorems.statement: ∀ (m ℓ : ℕ) (a : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), (∀ i, 1 / 4 < a i ∧ a i < 3 / 4) → ∀ La : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), La = {y | ∃ J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), J.card = m + 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ k : ℤ, y i - a i = k} → IsClosed La ∧ (∀ (J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ))) (c : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), m + 2 ≤ J.card → (∀ i ∈ J, c i = a i) → c ∈ La) ∧ ∀ (J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ))) (c x y : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)) (s : ℝ), (∀ i ∈ J, c i = a i) → (∀ i ∉ J, c i = 0 ∨ c i = 1) → (∀ i ∉ J, x i = c i) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) → 0 < s → (∀ i, y i - c i = s * (x i - c i)) → y ∈ La → x ∈ La
